title: restored_closing_ unadmitted-reporting tests time out under parallel load: the fixture's real source measurement consumes the shared 250 ms capture deadline, so SessionStatus fails locally and backoff outruns the 60 s guard
outcome: The restored-closing repair tests prove their wake and recovery behavior without depending on real Git or filesystem I/O finishing within the fixture's 250 ms scripted RPC cap, so they pass deterministically under a parallel or loaded run.
acceptance: C1 (deterministic restart clock): Every restarted AppState in tests/engram_unadmitted_reporting_repairs.rs and tests/engram_unadmitted_runtime_reporting.rs is built on a scripted Engram budget clock chosen before boot, through the existing new_with_paths_engram_transport_and_clock_for_test, as the pre-restart fixture's state is. No product code, deadlock guard, RPC timeout or retry schedule changes.

C2 (regression, RED first): A test makes a restarted reporting state's source capture take longer than the fixture's 250 ms RPC cap and asserts that the adopted turn still emits its durable unadmitted observation without a coordinator wake. It fails on the real-clock restart (RED) and passes with the scripted restart clock.

C3 (focused proof on the exact input): A parallel run of the failing filter (turn_checks session_actions gate_write_guard read_only_quoted_separators) and a serial run of restored_closing_ both pass on the frozen input, with no restored_closing_ failure.
C4 (validation and landing): The review pair has no outstanding finding of Medium or higher, and the full gate passes on the exact tree submitted for landing.
